observations: plugin~ defines host audio input ports; installed reference documents two channels by default and optional logical channel arguments.

plugout~ defines audio output to host for audio effects and instruments. Installed prose includes legacy two-channel statements alongside Maximum Channels; current supported layouts were not executed and remain unresolved.
Parameters have distinct unique-per-patcher Long Name and compact Short Name; Type, Range/Enum, Initial, Unit Style, Exponent, Steps, Visibility and Undo metadata are explicit concepts.
Preview Mode documentation describes an editor copy and a track copy; the track copy is disabled while previewing, and preview introduces additional latency.
Preview Mode documentation says parameter state synchronizes when toggled, while arbitrary Max object memory does not; Max parameter edits in preview are undoable in Live.
limitations: Documentation describes declared product behavior; this static inventory does not observe audio, editor instance count, DSP continuity or port negotiation.
No proprietary documentation bodies, templates, patch graphs or assets are redistributed.
Port layout and editor ownership choices for Alive remain its own contract.
